title: Shopping now starts with AI, so our store must be built for agents
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gifts (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart; Amex built agent-purchase verification; Best Buy joined TikTok Shop.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream and Google now has a cross-retailer cart
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Shopify says AI discovery converts better; Google Universal Cart launched in US Search and Gemini. Our product feeds and checkout must work there.

points.headline: Agent-made purchases are becoming a payments and trust issue
points.detail: American Express launched a framework to verify purchases made by AI shopping agents. We should watch how issuers authenticate agent orders on our store.

points.headline: Best Buy joins TikTok Shop and Walmart bundles memberships
points.detail: Best Buy sells on TikTok Shop this holiday; Walmart merges Walmart+ and Sam’s Club Plus into one $120 plan. We should test TikTok Shop and weigh Walmart loyalty effects.

points.headline: Memory undersupply keeps PC costs and prices under pressure into 2027
points.detail: AI data center demand is lifting DRAM and NAND prices into Q4. We should plan pricing and inventory for higher costs and tighter supply.

points.headline: Holiday online demand grows, but affordability and AI shape choices
points.detail: Adobe: record $275.1B US online holiday sales (+6.7%); NRF: affordability shapes plans; Gartner: 34% would use GenAI for gifts. Plan value offers and AI-ready content.
